name: Docker
description: Plataforma líder de contenedores para compilar, empaquetar, distribuir y ejecutar aplicaciones de forma aislada y reproducible.

command.windows: if (Get-Command winget -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { winget install -e --id Docker.DockerDesktop --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements } elseif (Get-Command choco -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { choco install docker-desktop -y } else { Start-Process 'https://docs.docker.com/desktop/setup/install/windows-install/' }
command.linux: curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com -o /tmp/get-docker.sh && sudo sh /tmp/get-docker.sh && rm -f /tmp/get-docker.sh || (sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y docker.io)
command.darwin: which brew >/dev/null 2>&1 && brew install --cask docker || open 'https://docs.docker.com/desktop/setup/install/mac-install/'
